mapper.update: UPDATE lost_found_item SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lost_found_application WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM lost_found_application WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND applicant_uid = #{applicantUid} AND status IN ('pending', 'approved') AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM lost_found_application WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND status IN ('pending', 'approved') AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FROM lost_found_item i INNER JOIN lost_found_application a ON a.item_id = i.id WHERE i.publisher_uid = #{userUid} AND i.status = 0 AND a.status = 'pending' AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND i.is_deleted = 0 ) AS publishedPendingCount, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FROM lost_found_item i INNER JOIN lost_found_application a ON a.item_id = i.id WHERE a.applicant_uid = #{userUid} AND a.status IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND i.status = 0 AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND i.is_deleted = 0 ) AS appliedChangedCount
mapper.update: UPDATE lost_found_application SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE lost_found_item SET status = #{status}, resolved_application_id = #{applicationId}, returner_name = IF(#{status} = 1, #{applicantName}, returner_name), claimer_name = IF(#{status} = 3, #{applicantName}, claimer_name), return_time = IF(#{status} = 1, NOW(), return_time), claim_time = IF(#{status} = 3, NOW(), claim_time), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM lost_found_application a INNER JOIN lost_found_item i ON i.id = a.item_id WHERE i.publisher_uid = #{userUid} AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM lost_found_application WHERE applicant_uid = #{userUid} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'lost' AND status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lostActive, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'found' AND status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS foundActive FROM lost_found_item
